name: Figma
description: Figma designs and FigJam boards, opened without Figma. A .fig is the document rather than a picture of it, so the page is drawn from its own shapes and stays sharp however far in you go; beside it, the preview Figma saved, and a listing of the pages, the frames and their sizes, the fonts the design asks the machine for, what its text says and which components it is built from.
author: xverb
